errors.text_span: decreasing to approximately 1.15 BPC at 50,000 training steps
errors.evidence: The magenta line (SimSMoE Validating) ends at a value visibly lower than 1.15, approximately 1.13. Stating it is 1.15 is incorrect and also wrongly implies it finishes at the same level as the other line.
At 20,000 steps, the magenta line is at approximately 1.17, not 1.2. The line reaches 1.2 BPC at around 12,000 steps.
The description omits the markers used for each line (plus for XMoE and circle for SimSMoE), which are key visual elements for distinguishing the data series.
